ruleDefinitions.name: Chromium Browser Instance Executed With Custom Extension
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a Chromium based browser process with the 'load-extension' flag to start a instance with a custom extension

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-load\\-extension\\=.*"))
